title: Sales Administrator
description:
We are looking for a highly organised, proactive and detail-oriented Sales Administrator to join our team in St Mellons.

This is a key role within the business, taking responsibility for the full sales administration process, from initial customer enquiries and quotations through to order processing, dispatch and delivery. You will work closely with customers and colleagues across Sales, Production, Warehouse, Logistics and Finance to ensure orders are processed accurately, deadlines are met and customers receive an excellent level of service.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage customer orders from initial enquiry through to final delivery.
- Prepare quotations, order confirmations, invoices and relevant sales documentation.
- Monitor order progress, coordinate dispatch and proactively follow up on outstanding actions.
- Liaise with customers and internal departments to ensure orders are fulfilled accurately and on time.
- Prepare export and shipping documentation where required.
- Maintain accurate customer and order records and assist with sales reporting.
- Handle telephone enquiries, general correspondence and other office administration.

About You

You will be exceptionally organised, have excellent attention to detail and take pride in seeing tasks through to completion. You will be confident communicating with different departments, managing competing priorities and taking the initiative to resolve issues without needing constant supervision.

We are looking for someone who is dependable, customer-focused and comfortable taking ownership of their workload.

Ideally, you will have:

Experience in sales administration, order processing or a similar role.

Good IT skills and confidence using Microsoft Office.

Experience with Sage 200, Salesforce and export documentation.

Experience with these systems and export processes is advantageous but not essential, as training can be provided for the right candidate. A positive attitude, strong organisational skills and a willingness to learn are what matter most.

Salary & Benefits
- Salary (phone number removed) depending on experience
- 35-hour week
- Annual bonus and enhanced pension
- 24 days holiday + bank holidays
- Private healthcare
- BHSF Health Cash Plan
- Training, development, and career progression
- Regular staff and social events

All applications will be reviewed, and successful shortlisted candidates will be contacted directly. Thank you for your understanding.

In this role, you'll act as a key point of contact for learners throughout their qualification journey, providing support from registration and course access through to assessment, examination and certification.

Most importantly, you'll enjoy helping people succeed, proactively supporting learners at key milestones, answering queries and ensuring they have the guidance, resources and encouragement needed to achieve their qualifications.

Successfully managing multiple learners, deadlines and stakeholder requirements at the same time while maintaining exceptional attention to detail.

title: Commission Payments Administrator
description:
Commission Payments Administrator

Location: Cardiff

Salary: Competitive salary

We're recruiting for an established financial services business in Cardiff that's looking for someone with experience in payment processing, matching and reconciliation to join its team.

This could be a great opportunity for someone who has previously worked in commission administration within financial services, although we're equally interested in people from other backgrounds who have experience matching payments, investigating discrepancies and ensuring financial records are accurate.

Experience using intelliflo office (iO) would be particularly useful, but isn't essential. What's more important is having good experience working with payments, strong attention to detail and a methodical approach to your work.

The Business

We're working with an established and growing financial services business with a supportive and experienced team in Cardiff.

The business provides a range of operational and administrative services, with a strong focus on accuracy, efficiency and delivering a high standard of service.

They're now looking for someone to join their team and help manage the processing and reconciliation of commission payments.

The role is based in Cardiff, so you'll need to be able to attend the office.

The Role

You'll be involved in managing and reconciling commission payments, ensuring that money received is correctly matched, recorded and allocated.

Accuracy is particularly important in this role. There will be occasions when payments don't match the information held on the system, and you'll need to investigate these differences and help resolve them.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Processing and reconciling commission and fee payments.
- Matching incoming payments and commission statements against the appropriate records.
- Identifying unmatched payments, discrepancies or missing information and investigating the reasons.
- Ensuring commission payments are correctly recorded and allocated.
- Supporting the preparation and processing of commission payments.
- Maintaining accurate payment records and updating relevant systems.
- Liaising with colleagues and external organisations to resolve payment queries.
- Using spreadsheets and internal systems to check information and maintain accurate financial records.

It's a role that would suit someone who enjoys working with figures, solving discrepancies and making sure everything balances correctly.

The Person

We're looking for someone who already has experience working with payments, reconciliations or financial transactions and understands the importance of getting the details right.

You might currently work in commission administration, income reconciliation, accounts administration, finance or a similar position involving payment matching.

Ideally, you'll be someone who:
- Has previous experience processing, matching or reconciling payments.
- Is comfortable working with financial information and identifying discrepancies.
- Has excellent attention to detail and a methodical approach.
- Is confident using Excel and other financial or administrative systems.
- Enjoys investigating problems and finding out why figures don't match.
- Can manage their workload and work accurately to deadlines.
- Communicates clearly and works well with colleagues.
- Takes responsibility for resolving queries and following things through.

Experience using intelliflo office (iO) would be a real advantage, particularly if you've worked with its commission and income reconciliation functions.

However, this isn't essential. We're happy to consider someone who has worked with other systems and has the right experience in payment matching and reconciliation.

Ultimately, we're looking for someone who takes pride in accuracy, enjoys working with financial information and can bring a reliable and organised approach to the role.

What's On Offer

This is an opportunity to join an established and growing financial services business, working alongside an experienced and supportive team.
